text.위임자 세션 안에서 대상을 서브에이전트로 실행한다. 위임자가 판단해 부르: Runs the delegate as a subagent inside the delegator's session. The delegator decides when to call it, and the result comes back into the delegator's context. The delegate runs on the delegator's backend.
text.이 에이전트가 실행 중 사용자에게 되묻거나 도구 사용 승인을 받을 수 있: Lets this agent ask the user questions or get approval for tool use during a run.
text.에이전트가 일하는 도중 사용자에게 묻거나 승인을 받을 수 있게 하는 연결: Edge settings that let the agent ask the user or get approval while it works.
text.에이전트가 열 수 있는 요청 종류입니다(예: 되묻기만). 비우면 이 연결: Request kinds the agent can open (e.g. questions only). Leave empty for every kind of this edge.
Pick this to allow only questions or only approvals.
How long to wait for an answer. Leave empty to follow the interaction settings.
Set this to use a different wait time for this edge's questions only.
text.답이 없을 때 요청만 닫을지(expire) 실행을 취소할지(cancel_: With no answer, whether to close only the request (expire) or cancel the run (cancel_run). Leave empty to use the setting.
Same as handoff. Use handoff for new edges.
text.위 에이전트가 스스로 판단해 필요할 때 아래 에이전트를 부른다. 아래 에: The upper agent decides on its own when to call the lower agent. The lower agent runs separately with its own session, model and resources, and can delegate again or ask the user.
How work is handed off. Leave empty to use the default of this edge type.
Pick this to hand off work differently from the default of this edge type.
text.맡은 에이전트의 결과 글 전체(text, 기본)나 답변 연결로 고른 답변: Returns the delegate's whole result text (text, default) or the reply chosen by its reply edge (reply).
text.맡은 에이전트의 긴 결과 대신 정리된 답변만 받고 싶을 때 reply로: Change this to reply to get only the tidy reply instead of the delegate's long result.
text.독립 에이전트로 넘기기: Hand off to an independent agent
text.위 노드가 끝나면 결과를 아래 노드에 넘긴다. 아래 노드는 별도 세션으로: When the upper node finishes, its result is passed to the lower node. The lower node runs in a separate session.
text.위 노드의 결과를 앞 단계로 되돌려 그 사이 노드들을 다시 실행한다. 최: Sends the upper node's result back to an earlier step and runs the nodes in between again. Once the maximum number of iterations is reached, it stops going back and the upper node's other edges continue.
text.이 연결로 되돌아가는 최대 횟수입니다. 비우면 흐름 설정, 그다음 기본값: Maximum number of times to go back through this edge. Leave empty to use the team setting, then the default.
Change this to allow more or fewer rewrite loops on this edge only.
Sends the user's message to this node. The node it reaches becomes the entry.
Key to take from the run input. Leave empty for the message body ('text').
text.꺼낸 값을 감쌀 틀입니다. {message}가 꺼낸 값이고 실행 입력의: Template that wraps the value taken. {message} is that value, and you can use other keys of the run input too.
text.위 노드가 실패했을 때만 오류 정보를 아래 노드에 넘긴다. 이 연결이 지: Passes error information to the lower node only when the upper node fails. Once this edge is taken, the failure counts as handled.
Sends this node's result to the user as a reply (intermediate nodes too).
Name shown at the top of the reply in chat.
Fill this in to tell replies apart when the team sends several.
Order in which replies are shown when there are several (smaller is higher).
When off, this reply is shown collapsed as an 'intermediate result'.
Turn this off to keep intermediate results collapsed.
Whether chat shows the text being written while it runs.
text.위 에이전트가 스스로 판단해 필요할 때 아래 에이전트를 부른다. 아래 에: The upper agent decides on its own when to call the lower agent. The lower agent runs inside the upper agent's session, and the result comes back to the upper agent.
Attaches a resource (instructions, files, MCP and so on) to the agent. It doesn't run.
Resource edge settings (how it is attached).
text.더하기(add, 기본), 에이전트·팀에서 붙인 같은 자리 바꾸기(repl: Add (add, default), replace the same slot attached by the agent or team (replace), or remove (remove).
text.에이전트·팀에서 붙인 리소스를 이 연결로 바꾸거나 빼고 싶을 때 바꾸세요: Change this to replace or remove, through this edge, a resource attached by the agent or team.
Resource setting values to change for this edge only.
text.위 노드가 끝나면 결과를 조건으로 확인해, 조건이 맞을 때만 아래 노드에: When the upper node finishes, its result is checked against the condition and passed to the lower node only if the condition matches (e.g. if the output contains 'PASS').
text.조건 연결 설정. 조건을 비우면 항상 지나간다(저장 전 검사 warnin: Condition edge settings. With an empty condition the edge is always taken (pre-save check warning).
text.앞 노드 결과(출력·구조화 결과·반복 회차)로 지나갈지 정하는 조건입니다: Condition on the previous node's result (output, structured result, loop iteration) that decides whether to pass. Leave empty to always pass.
Add conditions to send results down different paths.
The agent asks the user during a run (choices or a free answer).
Question → the chosen label (a list for multiple choice) or typed input.
Free answer (an answer typed in the chat message box goes here).
Midway through the team, the user looks at the content and decides (approve, reject and so on).
Edited content (when the decision allows edit).
The agent gets user approval before using a tool.
Message for the agent, such as the reason for denying.
text.에이전트 정의 하나의 자리. 층 설정·리소스·위임으로 실행 백엔드를 호출: A slot for one agent definition. Calls the execution backend with layered settings, resources and delegation.
text.팀 구성 안 에이전트 자리. 정의를 참조하고, 이 팀에서만 쓸 역할·설정: An agent slot in a team. It refers to a definition and adds a role and settings used only in this team.
Agent to place in this slot.
Pick this to place a different agent in this slot.
The job it does in this team. Leave empty to use the agent's role.
Fill this in when the same agent does a different job in this team.
text.다른 에이전트가 이 에이전트에게 맡길지 고를 때 보는 설명입니다. 비우면: Description other agents read when deciding whether to hand work to this agent. Leave empty to use the agent's description.
text.이 팀 안에서만 덮어쓸 에이전트 설정입니다. 비운 항목은 에이전트·팀·공: Agent settings to override in this team only. Empty items follow the agent, team and common settings.
Change this to use the same agent with a different model or tools in this team only.
text.이 에이전트가 일을 맡길 때 위임 방식마다 쓸 설정입니다. 비우면 방식: Settings per delegation strategy for when this agent hands off work. Leave empty to use the strategy defaults.
text.지침·파일·MCP 서버 등 리소스. 연결한 에이전트에 붙는다(실행되지 않: A resource such as instructions, files or an MCP server. It's attached to the connected agents (it doesn't run).
Resource to place in this slot. It's attached to the connected agents.
Pick this to give the connected agents a different resource.
text.다른 팀 구성을 노드 하나로 넣는다. 실행하면 그 팀 구성이 자식 실행으: Puts another team in as a single node. When run, that team runs as a child run.
Settings that put another team in this slot and run it as one step.
Team to put in this slot.
Pick this to put a different team in this slot.
Team version to use. Leave empty to use the latest version at run time.
Pin this so that editing the inner team doesn't change how this team behaves.
text.받은 값이 객체일 때 안쪽 팀에 넘길 키입니다. 비우면 받은 값을 그대로: Key to pass to the inner team when the received value is an object. Leave empty to pass the received value as is.
text.안쪽 팀 답변 중 결과로 쓸 이름 목록입니다. 비우면 최종 답변 전부를: Names of the inner team's replies to use as the result. Leave empty to join all final replies in order.
Pick this to use only some of the inner team's replies as the result.
text.답변 여러 개를 합칠 때 사이에 넣는 문자열입니다. 기본은 빈 줄 하나입: String placed between replies when joining several. The default is one blank line.
text.이 자리에서만 안쪽 팀의 설정을 덮어씁니다. 비우면 안쪽 팀 설정을 그대: Overrides the inner team's settings in this slot only. Leave empty to use the inner team's settings as is.
Change this to run the inner team with a different model or settings in this slot only.
text.채팅하는 사용자. 메시지·답변·되묻기 연결의 끝이고, 흐름 중간에 두면: The user in the chat. The end of message, reply and question edges; placed midway through the team, it reviews.
Title shown at the top of the review card.
Change this to make it easier for the reviewer to see what they are looking at.
Guidance text shown to the reviewer.
Fill this in to tell the reviewer what to check.
text.고를 수 있는 결정입니다(예: 승인·반려). 결정마다 출력 포트가 하나: Decisions to choose from (e.g. approve, reject). Each decision gets its own output port.
Add decisions when you need choices other than approve and reject.
text.결정 포트로 낼 값의 틀입니다. {content}·{edited}·{fe: Template of the value sent out of the decision port. You can use {content}, {edited}, {feedback} and so on. Leave empty to send the content as is.
Shape in which to open the review card. You usually don't change this.
How long to wait for the review. Leave empty to follow the interaction settings.
Set this so the review is not waited on for too long.
text.답이 없을 때 요청만 닫을지(expire) 실행을 취소할지(cancel_: With no answer, decides whether to close only the request (expire) or cancel the run (cancel_run).
text.사용자 자리 설정입니다. 중간 검토를 켜면 흐름으로 들어온 값을 사람이: User slot settings. With midway review on, a person checks the value coming through the team before it is passed on.
Lets a person look at the value coming through the team and approve, reject or edit it.
Turn this on to have a person check agent results before they are passed on.
Check the content, then approve it or edit it.
Hand off when there are security-related changes.

codes.agent.backend_failed: The execution backend ended with a failure.
codes.agent.lookup_unavailable: No agent definition lookup service was provided.
codes.agent.mixed_strategies: This node's delegates mix delegation strategies that can't run together.
codes.agent.no_backend: No backend is set to run this agent. Choose an execution backend in the node settings or in the common defaults in Settings.
codes.agent.resources_unavailable: Attached resources aren't passed on because no resource lookup service is available.
codes.files.invalid_item: A file item wasn't passed on (a problem with its format, name or content).
codes.files.unavailable: Files aren't passed on because the run folder couldn't be determined.
codes.files.unsafe_path: A file isn't passed on because its path is outside the run folder.
codes.files.write_failed: A file isn't passed on because it couldn't be written.
codes.review.expired: The time to wait for the review response ran out.
codes.review.reserved_port: A decision id clashes with the user node's output port name.
codes.team.invalid_settings: The child team settings override is invalid.
codes.user.not_reviewable: This user node has no review settings (review), so it can't handle input from the team.
